description: This file defines an interface and implementation for executing system commands, wrapping os/exec functionalities, and handling errors related to command execution within the Kubernetes utils package.

classes.name: executor
classes.description: Implementation of the Interface that uses os/exec to run commands.

classes.name: cmdWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper around os/exec.Cmd to add error handling and additional methods.

classes.name: ExitErrorWrapper
classes.description: Wraps os/exec.ExitError to implement the ExitError interface.

classes.name: CodeExitError
classes.description: Represents an exit error with an associated error object and exit code.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the executor implementing the Interface.

methods.name: maskErrDotCmd
methods.description: Reverts behavior of osexec.Cmd to before Go 1.19, masking ErrDot errors.

methods.name: maskErrDot
methods.description: Masks ErrDot errors if present.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: Creates a Cmd instance for executing a command.

methods.name: CommandContext
methods.description: Creates a Cmd instance with context for executing a command.

methods.name: LookPath
methods.description: Wraps os/exec.LookPath to find an executable in PATH.

methods.name: SetDir
methods.description: Sets the working directory for the command.

methods.name: SetStdin
methods.description: Sets the standard input for the command.

methods.name: SetStdout
methods.description: Sets the standard output for the command.

methods.name: SetStderr
methods.description: Sets the standard error for the command.

methods.name: SetEnv
methods.description: Sets environment variables for the command.

methods.name: StdoutPipe
methods.description: Returns a pipe to read the command's standard output.

methods.name: StderrPipe
methods.description: Returns a pipe to read the command's standard error.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the command execution.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the command to finish.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs the command to completion.

methods.name: CombinedOutput
methods.description: Runs the command and returns combined stdout and stderr.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Runs the command and returns stdout.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Sends SIGTERM to stop the process, and SIGKILL if it does not exit after 10 seconds.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors from command execution, wrapping or returning specific errors.

methods.name: ExitStatus
methods.description: Returns the exit status code from an ExitError.
